-34.90905,138.59211: Row Houses. This row of Victorian attached cottages were built between 1857 and 1859 for Moses Firth who rented the then eleven cottages out. Shortly afterwards he sold the row to R. Raphael who continued to lease the properties, however by 1880 the number of cottages was reduced to nine. There are now only four remaining from the original row.
-34.92264,138.60561: The Case of the Wandering Spirit Arthur Conan Doyle in Australia Arthur Conan Doyle (1859-1930), creator of Sherlock Holmes, visited Adelaide in 1920 and stayed at Gibson's Grand Central Hotel which previously occupied this site.
